description: This source file defines the internal class 'VersionSelectorManager' responsible for managing version selection strategies for grains in Orleans VNext. It includes methods for getting and setting version selectors based on grain interface types and configuration strategies.

classes.name: VersionSelectorManager
classes.description: Manages version selectors for grain interfaces, allowing retrieval and configuration of strategies.

methods.name: VersionSelectorManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the manager with a service provider and options, setting the default and specific version selectors.

methods.name: GetSelector
methods.description: Returns the version selector for a specific grain interface type, defaulting if none is set.

methods.name: SetSelector
methods.description: Sets the default version selector based on a strategy.

methods.name: SetSelector
methods.description: Sets or removes a version selector for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: ResolveVersionSelector
methods.description: Resolves and returns a version selector based on a given strategy.
